products.reason_for_recall: Traditional flavor of Native Catch Salmon Bacon product is recalled because it has the potential to be contaminated with Clostridium botulinum. The potential for contamination was noted after a routine Washington State Department of Agriculture (WSDA) inspection discovered that the product had potentially been under processed.
